verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws. The red panel's lower ~40% is empty dead space under the attribution. The skyline no longer overlaps the red panel as it did in the original, and floats in a separate white band. The decorative tick lines and grey background stripes look arbitrary. A keeps the skyline full-bleed and anchored to the bottom, like the original. B shrinks it into a hard-edged rectangle with visibly clipped left and right ends, floating above the card's bottom edge with a white gap below, so it reads as a pasted-in crop.
